subject.title: [UX/Bug] Model selection array order is strictly bound to checkbox ticking sequence, causing unintended primary/fallback assignment

question: Should this report be transferred to OpenClaw or retained in ClawHub as a linked cross-repository tracker?
rationale: The report is concrete and vision-aligned, but its owning implementation is outside ClawHub and the related OpenClaw issue only partially captures the reported symptoms.

options.title: Transfer with reproduction
options.body: Transfer this issue to OpenClaw and preserve its reverse-selection and WebSocket synchronization details alongside the broader model-ordering tracker.

options.title: Retain linked tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open in ClawHub while linking https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80521 until runtime maintainers determine whether the root cause is shared.

recommendation.title: Transfer with reproduction
recommendation.body: Transfer this issue to OpenClaw and preserve its reverse-selection and WebSocket synchronization details alongside the broader model-ordering tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available local history signal for the ClawHub/OpenClaw configuration boundary and cross-repository routing.
